title: EntityModuleConfig
description: Config for one Entity module (a list of things — companies, contacts, vehicles…). Faithful EAV shape merged with v5's real entityconfig: column families (systemcolumns + optional streamcolumns/datacolumns/usercolumns/validation_columns) of field descriptors keyed by `col`, plus uiConfig + listcolumns — what the composer registers and config-render derives views from. Every node carries a stable `id` (tenant-model requirement).

code.description: Entity code in the store, e.g. crm/companies.

version.description: Optional definition version — the cache key for compileFieldSet (phase 2 §2). Bump on any field/placement change; absent → content-hash fallback.

views.description: Optional explicit view list for the module's view tabs. An entry is either the bare view KIND (e.g. "kanban") — label from the composer's VIEW_LABEL map — or an object { kind, label?, icon? } naming the module's own lens (e.g. { "kind": "dispatcher-cockpit", "label": "Dispatcher Cockpit", "icon": "radio" }). Wins over the module-type's default views when present (see `resolveModuleViews` / `resolveModuleViewSpecs` in `@fams/v5-composer`'s module-registry.ts) — threaded in by the consuming app's blueprint→ModuleBlueprint mapping (e.g. the demo env's `toModuleNode()`).

ViewSpec.description: A view tab entry: the bare view kind, or an object carrying the module's own label/icon for that kind. The engine only ever branches on `kind`; `label`/`icon` are module metadata.

label.description: Tab label override. Omit for the kind's default label.

icon.description: Tab glyph name, resolved against the icon set at render time.

FieldType.description: v5 frontend field type set. Aliases: BigText≡LongText, Numeric≡Number. Color/Assignee are optional forward-looking types the blueprint models explicitly — a v5 export maps Assignee → a reference with refModule:'Users', Color → a SmallText slot rendered as a color.

ReferenceKind.description: The domain a Single/MultiReference points at.

col.description: Storage slot: title | status | uniqueidentifier | tags | systemcol1..N | usercol1..N.

group.description: Catalog section for the columns chooser, e.g. 'Asset – Basic Info' (SPEC v2 §2.6 groups the OFF fields under uppercase category headers). Presentational only — never affects storage or resolution.

unit.description: Display unit appended after a numeric read value (5,061 km · 2,986 hrs · 1,200 AED). Column-level: it travels onto every descriptor for this column, so every surface reading the field prints the same unit. Lowest precedence — compileFieldSet's `units` option and component.props.unit/suffix both win.

creation.description: Field-level creation-form visibility and behavior (distinct from EntityModuleConfig.uiConfig.creation's form-level layout knobs). 'hidden: true' excludes this field from every create-sheet grouping bucket while leaving every other surface (detail grid, sections, kanban/list) unaffected. 'autofill' preselects this field's value when another field is edited to a matching value (still freely editable afterward) — see FieldDescriptor.creation in v5-composer's fields/types.ts.

autofill.description: One of three modes: equals/value (exact-match preselect), map (a whenCol-value -> target-value lookup table), or template (a '{col} · {col}' string built from current form values).

tone.description: Semantic lifecycle tone — DS-token-driven reading of this stage, preferred over `color` by renderers that support it.

textColor.description: Contrast-safe text override for `color`'s solid fill (e.g. a dark token hex for an amber/warning fill).

kind.description: How the filter field behaves and renders. Omitted ⇒ derived from the column metadata by deriveFilters().

optionsFrom.description: Where the filter field's options come from. Omitted ⇒ derived alongside kind.

optionDot.description: The leading dot on an option row. 'status' reads the option's own resolved color; 'tone' maps component.props.optionTone through the semantic tone tokens; false renders no dot. Defaults to 'status' for kind: 'status', else false.

icon.description: Kebab-case icon name for the field's 24px slot, from the shared field-glyph vocabulary (field-icons.tsx, formerly filter-icons.tsx). Falls back to 'filter' when omitted or unrecognized.

multiple.description: Multi vs. single selection. Defaults to true for every kind except date and single-select. false ⇒ radio rows that close on pick.

options.description: The option list, for optionsFrom: 'inline' only.

categoryCol.description: For kind: 'tags' — the option field carrying the chip's category. A real systemcolumns key.

expandable.description: true ⇒ the field's dropdown offers the ⧉ trigger that opens the full-table side-sheet selector. Legal only for kind: 'entity'.

expandView.description: The side-sheet table config — required for a meaningful expandable.

createFromSearch.description: Create-a-record-from-the-search-query affordance inside a filter field.

entity.description: Module code of the entity to create.

Rbac.description: RBAC config — which roles can access this module/screen. Free-form per consumer.

icon.description: Optional lucide icon name in kebab-case (e.g. "map-pin"), resolved dynamically by the consuming app's module rail (e.g. the demo env's `seams.tsx`) instead of its default per-module-id icon.

highlight.description: Card-level highlight color column — the record's value at `col` is a raw runtime color (e.g. '#f79009') applied to the card's own border; empty/absent renders no highlight. Generic flag slot, never a hardcoded concept.

boardClassName.description: Raw Tailwind utility classes merged onto the board's own scroll container (e.g. "gap-5 ps-5 pe-5") — opt-in escape hatch for a module needing a different column gap/scroll-edge padding than the shared KanbanBoard default. Omit for the default.

columnClassName.description: Raw Tailwind utility classes merged onto every column (e.g. "w-96") — opt-in escape hatch for a module needing wider columns than the shared KanbanColumn default. Omit for the default.

zones.description: Map zones for the zones drawer - each { id, points:[[lng,lat],...], color?, label?, parent?, fillOpacity?, tags?[] }. `tags` back the zones drawer's tag-filter buttons (SPEC v2 3.20).

records.description: Record-geometry map bindings — presence makes the hybrid lens the generic list+record-map view. Geometry is per record (point from latCol/lngCol, polygon from zoneCol), never a mode flag.

toolbar.description: Declarative in-panel toolbar for the record-map hybrid's list pane. Presence turns the toolbar on; controls derive facets/options from the module's own blueprint derivations.

card.description: Per-card display options for the hybrid list pane's card (SPEC 29:41877).

tags.description: Free-form tag labels backing the POI drawer's tag-filter buttons (SPEC v2 3.21). Presentational/filtering only.

category.description: DS POI category id (@fams/ui-kit's POI_CATEGORIES, e.g. 'port' / 'fuel-station' / 'hospital' / 'mosque' / 'government' — see assets/icons/poi/*.svg). Drives the category-glyphed PoiMarker on the map and PoiCategoryChip in the POI drawer; optional, falls back to the legacy kind-based glyph when absent or unrecognized.

pois.description: Points of interest for the map's POI drawer — checked POIs plot pins; position is [lng, lat].

expandedColumns.description: Extra list-panel columns (col keys) revealed at the hybrid list panel's Expanded / Fully Expanded width states.

tagsCol.description: Tags-like column whose values back the All Filters popover's Tags multiselect (first suggestion group, warning-tinted chips).

privateTagsCol.description: Second tags-like column — its values form the Tags multiselect's second suggestion group (grey outlined chips, e.g. a user's private tags). Same value shape as tagsCol.

columnsShown.description: The Columns popover's default Shown set (systemcolumn ids or col keys). Decoupled from the collapsed table columns (hybrid.listColumns); omitted → the popover seeds from the collapsed columns.

vehicleTypeCol.description: Vehicle-type column (e.g. "Tanker") — the mixed Name·ID·Type·Location list's Type column for a vehicle row (2026-08-31 workforce enhancement).

activityCol.description: Column whose record value is an array of { icon?, count, tone? } pairs — the compact icon+count Activity Overview cell.

fillLevelCol.description: Column whose record value is a number 0-100 (or numeric string) rendered as a colored progress bar + percentage in the hybrid list's FILL LEVEL column. Generic — header label comes from the bound systemcolumn's own name.

vehicleArt.description: Which VehicleIcon3D illustration the map marker, list-row cell, and popup header render for every record in this module. Generic, config-driven; omitted → 'car'.

workforce.description: Workforce bindings (2026-08-31 enhancement). Presence of kindCol turns on the Live Monitoring All/Vehicle/Workforce chips and the mixed Name·ID·Type·Location list columns; omitted, the module renders exactly as before.

kindCol.description: Discriminator column: a record whose value here reads 'workforce' (case-insensitive) is a workforce member; every other value is a vehicle.

statusCol.description: on-duty | on-break | in-transit, case-insensitive; unbound/unrecognized reads as on-duty.

locationKindCol.description: plain | zone | poi, case-insensitive; unbound/unrecognized reads as plain.

popup.description: Workforce popup card bindings (2026-08-31 workforce-popup task) — same tabbed contract as uiConfig.map.popup with the Shifts vocabulary.

format.description: Display formatting for a plain label/value cell. 'number' groups the value's digits with the locale thousands separator (132800 -> 132,800) before any suffix is appended; non-numeric values pass through untouched. Opt-in per field, because a blanket numeric test would also group years and model numbers.

kind.description: Cell shape. 'coordinates' renders the latCol/lngCol pair with a copy affordance; 'progress' renders col's 0-100 number as the board's bar + percentage; 'tags' renders col's array (or comma-separated string) as a tinted chip row.

thresholds.description: kind: 'progress' only — value thresholds mapping the number onto a bar tone, matched highest-first.

tagTones.description: kind: 'tags' only — per-tag tone by exact label; unlisted tags render neutral.

cluster.description: Opt-in marker clustering for the generic record-map hybrid lens, same supercluster pipeline + eye toggle Live Monitoring's fleet map already ships. Omitted/false keeps one circle per record (never aggregated).

markerDetailZoom.description: Zoom at or above which map markers render their info capsule (plate + fill level / speed) instead of the plain pin. Omitted → the design's own threshold.

popup.description: Vehicle popup card bindings — the Overview grid's authored field list plus the columns feeding the Critical Events / Trips / Workforce / Devices tab bodies.

format.description: Display formatting for a plain label/value cell. 'number' groups the value's digits with the locale thousands separator (132800 -> 132,800) before any suffix is appended; non-numeric values pass through untouched. Opt-in per field, because a blanket numeric test would also group years and model numbers.

kind.description: Cell shape. 'coordinates' renders the latCol/lngCol pair with a copy affordance; 'progress' renders col's 0-100 number as the board's bar + percentage; 'tags' renders col's array (or comma-separated string) as a tinted chip row.

thresholds.description: kind: 'progress' only — value thresholds mapping the number onto a bar tone, matched highest-first.

tagTones.description: kind: 'tags' only — per-tag tone by exact label; unlisted tags render neutral.

workforce.description: The popup's Workforce tab (Figma 16:22182) — the assigned crew's info card. An entry whose column is empty is skipped; with nothing bound the tab shows its empty state.

photoCol.description: Column holding an image URL for the 120x120 photo tile.

visibleTabs.description: Ordered ids of the tabs pinned to the popup's visible tab bar; the rest go to its overflow menu. Omitted, the first `maxVisibleTabs` are pinned.

maxVisibleTabs.description: How many tab segments the popup's bar shows before its overflow slot. Defaults to 3.

address.description: Full "District, Municipality, Country" line — the muted subtitle of a gazetteer row in the map search. Authored here, never derived (the design system ships no gazetteer and geocodes nothing).

places.description: Named places the map's place-search filters and flies to, and can drop a POI pin on (SPEC v2 3.18). The design system ships no gazetteer and performs no geocoding - it takes this list as a generic search source, so every place name is application data supplied here.

gazetteer.description: Opt-in bundled places/districts/landmarks dataset the map's 'search anything' matches against as extra `place`-kind rows, alongside `places`/`zones`/`pois`/assets. The design system ships no gazetteer by default — this key names a deployment's own bundled dataset (currently only "qatar", `qatarGazetteer` from `@fams/v5-templates`); omit for a deployment with no bundled dataset.

message.description: Message raised as a toast when the tool is activated.

unavailableTools.description: Map tools that render and stay focusable/clickable but are not wired to a live data source in this deployment: activating one raises `message` as a toast instead of toggling. The design system holds no environment-specific copy - the message text is always supplied here.

tools.description: Which floating map tools render, by id, AND — for the top-end stack (layers, traffic, weather, incidents, poi, zones) — the ORDER they render in, top to bottom. Omitted, the map renders the reference set (search, cluster, layers, traffic, zones, poi) in that order — no drop-pin, no refresh, no weather, no incidents.

incidentsModule.description: The `code` of another module (e.g. "incidents/incident") whose records paint as severity-coloured pins on THIS map and list as cards in the Incidents panel (the `incidents` tool, SPEC 19:23006 #4) — a cross-module overlay, resolved by the app's `resolveModuleRecords` host seam. Omit and the Incidents tool renders with no overlay (a tool cannot render for data the blueprint never declared).

weather.description: Weather monitoring overlay for the live map (Figma section 22:41486): colour-banded temperature station markers, an overlay checkbox row (Stations / Rain Heat-map / Clouds / Precipitation) and a docked station detail drawer. Every reading, forecast and outlook row is APPLICATION DATA authored here — the design system ships no weather feed and calls no weather service (no OpenWeatherMap tiles, no Open-Meteo requests); the rain/cloud/precipitation washes are generated from a deterministic seeded field, exactly as the traffic overlay is.

enabled.description: Renders the map's weather tool (default false). The layer itself starts OFF and is the user's own choice; pressing the tool reveals the overlay checkbox row and the station markers.

stations.description: The weather stations to plot. A non-empty array is what makes the layer available at all; position is [lng, lat].

area.description: Zone/area label shown as the drawer's leading chip, e.g. "Area 9".

active.description: Whether this station is currently in service. `false` is the generic Inactive-station contract: the drawer still shows identity (name/area/coordinates) but renders a single "No recent data" empty state for the readings grid, and forces the trend chart/forecast/daily tables to their own empty states regardless of whatever reading/trend/forecast/daily this station happens to carry. Omit (default true) for every station that reports normally.

reading.description: The current observation. OMIT ENTIRELY for a station that is not reporting — it then renders the grey no-data marker and a dashed detail grid rather than a broken-looking empty one.

readingAt.description: Pre-formatted observation timestamp, e.g. "25/08/2026, 15:20". Authored here, never a live clock.

trend.description: The drawer's "Last 24 hours" temperature trend. A null tempC marks a gap the line breaks at.

forecast.description: The drawer's hourly forecast table (48 rows in the reference data).

rainMm.description: QMD's official daily rainfall total, mm (rain-first deployments, 2026-08-31). Optional — omitted, the QMD grid's Rain row falls back to its 'no data' dash.

forecast.description: The map's bottom forecast panel, shown while the weather layer is on: a collapsed rain-legend + model-tab strip that expands into the Open-Meteo hourly timeline / QMD 10-day outlook grids with an About Location rail. All rows are authored application data.

location.description: The expanded panel's About Location rail. Every string pre-formatted.

openMeteo.description: The Open-Meteo tab's day columns: a day header plus its hour cells (time is the short in-day label, e.g. "08:00").

qmd.description: The QMD tab's 10-day official outlook columns.

rainMm.description: QMD's official daily rainfall total, mm (rain-first deployments, 2026-08-31). Optional — omitted, the QMD grid's Rain row falls back to its 'no data' dash.

trafficOverlay.description: Renders the map's traffic tool (default true). The overlay itself always starts OFF and is the user's own persisted choice; set false to drop the control entirely. The overlay paints deterministic pseudo-traffic along the basemap's major roads - FAMS ships no live traffic feed.

labelOverrides.description: Basemap label renames. Each rule rewrites the rendered label of the matching feature on the style's water/marine label layers (matched against name, name:en and name_en) and is re-applied after every basemap switch. Labels in other languages are untouched.

attribution.description: How the basemap attribution strip renders. 'visible' (default) paints the full, never-truncated OSM/ODbL credit line; 'compact' collapses it behind MapLibre's 'i' affordance; 'hidden' renders no attribution control at all. Whether a deployment may discharge the credit obligation somewhere other than the map is the deployment's decision and responsibility.

stationDrawer.description: true routes the record-map hybrid's record-open to the docked weather-station drawer, matching the record to weather.stations by name/id.

hideFullscreenControl.description: Suppress the detached fullscreen tile under the 'figma' zoom pill (per-module opt-out, 2026-09-01 - Requests & Complaints). The zoom pill and every other tool stay; default false (unchanged).

fieldEmphasis.description: FieldGrid label/value weight for the top-level details grid. 'strong' matches Gilroy:SemiBold Figma sources (e.g. the incident Task Detail sheet); default 'regular' preserves the original Ticket/Lease Detail look. See FieldGrid's emphasis prop in @fams/ui-kit.
FieldGrid label/value weight override for this section's own FieldGrid (ignored when component is set). See ProfileSection.layout in types.ts.

showLabel.description: Show this section's name as a heading in the CREATE sheet's flat layout. Default false — see ProfileSection.showLabel in types.ts.

detailHidden.description: Exclude this section from the DETAIL page's accordion list while it still fully participates in CREATE grouping. Default false — see ProfileSection.detailHidden in types.ts.

visibleWhen.description: Rule-evaluator Condition (same shape as pipeline rules), evaluated with {user, task: record}; when false, TaskDetail hides this section. See ProfileSection.visibleWhen in types.ts.
Rule-evaluator Condition (same shape as pipeline rules), evaluated with the {user, task} scope where $.task.* is the profiled RECORD.

requiredPrivileges.description: Every listed privilege must be in userContext.privileges for the tab to render.

infoTitle.description: Section label above the identity-pane detail rows (default 'Details').

placeholderIcon.description: Named-icon vocabulary for the identity panel's placeholder graphic when no image/avatar is available (e.g. 'map-pin'). See UiConfig.profile.placeholderIcon in types.ts.

statusOverlayField.description: Field(s) driving the identity rail's status chip; first non-empty wins. Defaults to the record's own `status`.

statusOverlayColors.description: Solid pill colour per statusOverlayField value, for values outside uiConfig.statusList.

identityVariants.description: Per-record-shape overrides of the identity rail; the first variant whose whenField value matches wins.

filtersPanel.description: Panel-level chrome for the All Filters panel. All numbers are px and are clamped by the renderer against the viewport. Defaults: title 'All Filters', clearAll true, width 448, height 660, sheetWidth 722.

placeholder.description: The toolbar search box's placeholder text (e.g. 'Search Ticket'). Omit for the generic 'Search {module label}' default.

recordNoun.description: Singular/plural record noun for generated copy ("Delete 12 tasks?", "Showing 175 of 175 mapped tasks"). Omit to derive it from the module name; set it when the module name is not a plural of its records (e.g. "Pipeline Management").

listRowHeight.description: List view's body-row vertical rhythm (see DataTable.rowHeight). Omit for the template's own default ('lg').

listSort.description: Hides the toolbar's Sort control when false. Omit/true keeps it shown (default).

listSelectable.description: Shows a leading checkbox column for multi-row selection. Omit/false keeps today's default (no selection column).

kanbanSelectable.description: Hides the kanban card's bulk-selection checkbox when false (no bulk actions in kanban). Omit/true keeps it shown (default).

kanbanReadOnly.description: true disables drag-to-change-status on the kanban board entirely (every lane denies every drop); status changes only via the detail view's own transition control. Omit/false keeps today's default.

groupByOptions.description: Curated option set for the shared toolbar's Group By control (Figma overlay 33534:31649). Narrows and re-labels the auto-derived groupable columns; omit for all of them. 'None' is rendered by the control itself and is never authored here. An entry's 'default' marks the grouping a grouped-list view opens with (ignored by other view kinds). An entry's 'icon' is the leading glyph its group-header rows carry.

icon.description: Leading glyph for this grouping's group-header rows, by name from the shared field-glyph vocabulary (field-icons.tsx, formerly filter-icons.tsx). Omit for no glyph.

rowActions.description: Per-record hover-revealed row/card options menu (Figma overlay 33534:32262) — exactly Delete (destructive, confirmed) + Archive (a disabled placeholder). Shared across List rows, Hybrid cards and Kanban cards. Omit for no row menu.

alwaysVisible.description: Paint the `…` control at rest instead of hover-revealing it. Opt-in: omit to keep the shared hover default. Resting look only — the button is mounted, focusable and named in both modes.

bulkActions.description: Bulk action bar shown while at least one record is selected (Figma Dev Note 33534:32267) — exactly Delete + Export. Gated by listSelectable; omit to accept the selection-driven default, pass {} for a selection column with no bar.

listHeaderAction.description: Shows the list toolbar's trailing header-only pencil/edit affordance (default Pencil glyph, no click behavior). Omit/false keeps today's default (no trailing column).

viewPickerHint.description: Hint line for the module's 'Select Preferred View' new-view picker. Omit to hide the hint row entirely.

label.description: Create-CTA label (e.g. 'New Collection Point'); falls back to 'Create New'.

disabled.description: Hides the module-header 'New X' CTA and every inline create-from-empty-facet affordance derived from it. Read-only affordances are untouched. Use when the create flow is not yet implemented / disabled by policy; the rest of this block (label/layout/chrome) is still authorable for when the flow reopens.

explicit.description: Suppresses the create form's trailing catch-all 'Details' group — only the implicit Basic-Info group plus fields explicitly placed in profile.sections appear.

basicCount.description: Size of the implicit first 'Basic Info' group (default 5). Set it when a wizard's first step must contain an exact field count; fields beyond it flow into profile.sections steps.

showSummaryStep.description: Appends a synthesized read-only Summary/review step to the wizard, derived from the OTHER groups' entered values (it needs no profile.sections entry of its own); each section carries an Edit affordance back to its step. Wizard path only; ignored by 'flat'. Default off.

stepperVariant.description: Step-nav treatment for the wizard rail — Stepper's own variant. 'numbered' (default) is the numbered/icon circle rail; 'tabs' is the horizontal text-tab strip. Ignored by the 'flat' path.

stepIcons.description: Per-step rail icon keyed by CreationGroup id ('basic', a profile.sections entry's own id, the trailing 'details' bucket, or 'summary'). Values are icon NAMES from the shared FIELD_ICON_VOCABULARY (the same closed set IconTextView's props.icon resolves through); an unknown name falls back to the default numbered/check marker rather than throwing.

cockpit.description: Operations-cockpit lens options for the hybrid view kind (see UiConfig.cockpit in types.ts). Presence of this block on a module that also binds coordinates via uiConfig.map switches the hybrid view body to the CockpitView lens (KPI strip + card queue + live map + status-panel band). A view option on an existing module type, never a new module type.

alertBar.description: Module-header alert strip pinned above the filters row (attendance's dispatching-conflicts bar). Clicking opens a side sheet listing the records matched by `filter`.

message.description: Message template; '{count}' is replaced with the matched-record count.

listColumns.description: systemcolumn ids shown in the compact left list of the hybrid view.

stageTabs.description: Stage tabs — a CountTabs row above the hybrid's compact left list: 'All' plus one tab per uiConfig.statusList entry, each with a live count. Selecting a stage narrows the list to it and suppresses the per-row STATUS pill (both return on 'All'). Requires a non-empty uiConfig.statusList.

hideResultsCount.description: Hides the 'Showing N of M' results-count line across this module's lenses when true.

viewSwitcher.description: false hides the shared toolbar's list/grid display-mode segmented switcher for this module.

recordAutomation.description: Declarative cross-module side effects — the generic 'when this column reaches this value, create a record in another module and reference it back' vocabulary. Evaluated by the pure evalRecordAutomations() (@fams/v5-composer's automation.ts); the consuming app performs the actual create/patch. Carries no business vocabulary — col/entityType/target column keys are opaque strings the blueprint author supplies.

id.description: Stable identity — same convention as every other blueprint node id.

when.description: Fires when `col`'s value BECOMES exactly `equals` (an enter transition — does not fire if `col` already equaled `equals` before the patch, so it never refires on a later unrelated patch).

values.description: Target column → value mapping, resolved against the source record (its previous value merged with the incoming patch).

fromCol.description: Copies a source column's value verbatim.

patchSource.description: Optional patch applied back onto the source record once the target record exists.

fromCreated.description: Names a column on the just-created target record (typically "id") for the back-reference.

listGroupBy.description: Hides the toolbar's Group By control when false.
